title: Internal software project costs: capitalization review
prompt: Review internal software project costs and supporting descriptions for potential capitalization under the applicable accounting policy and guidance.

inputs.name: Projects and time entries for the quarter
General ledger for software development and payroll accounts

steps: read the capitalization policy and the project descriptions; determine each project's stage (preliminary, application development, post-implementation) from the documentation, citing the guidance paragraphs and marking each "verify"
pull the projects, time entries and the related general ledger lines for the quarter
for each project, split costs by stage and by nature (internal payroll, contractors, licences, training); list which could qualify under the policy and which cannot
list the facts missing to conclude (stage dates, probability of completion, intended use)
write the memo with a preliminary view per project and the workbook of costs by project, stage and nature

done.text: The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
The memo exists as a pdf
Every exception row (a cost whose stage is unknown, a project without documentation) cites the project id and the time entry or transaction id
software-capitalization.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Project costs on the Detail sheet tie to the general ledger lines pulled for the quarter; no entry is proposed
